milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the jungle sign at spawn-relative (3, 0, 2) and face it to 'read' the directional text. max_distance=16 allows reading from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the sign.

Uses inventory_has because mining fully-grown potato crops (age=7) drops potato items into the player's inventory. No potatoes exist in the starting inventory, so any potato in inventory confirms successful harvesting from the farm.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone sword (2 cobblestone + 1 stick on crafting table) places the result in the player's inventory. No stone sword exists in the scene initially, so its presence in inventory confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because smelting raw rabbit in the furnace with coal produces cooked_rabbit which the player picks up into inventory. No cooked rabbit exists in the scene initially (only raw rabbit in chest and on rabbits), so its presence confirms successful furnace smelting.
